    phoneme: "s",

    onset: 0,
    startWord: 0,
    midWord: 0,
    endWord: 1,
    condition: {
      leftContext: [leftSound],
      leftGraphemeContext: PLURAL_LOOKING_LEFT_LETTERS,
      wordFinal: true,
    },
  }));
}
